subject: NovaPay latency surge: peak-backoff and quota-window mismatch — exec attention requested
messages:
From: Thomas Nguyen <thomas@novapay.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-27T08:13:45-07:00
Subject: Sudden latency & 503 spike this morning (Novapay prod)

Vivek —

We're seeing a huge uptick in tail latency and 5xx responses across our payment reconciliation endpoints between 07:50–08:05 PDT. Traffic was within our normal peak (no change on our side) but response times jumped from ~120ms median to 2–6s and our retries pushed error rates up. Attaching sample logs.

Key symptoms:
- ~12% 503s for tokenized/generate calls for a 30-second window
- Large queue depths on your endpoint (logs show many blocked requests waiting for token bucket refill)
- Customer-facing timeouts and retry storms from our side

We have an SLA review scheduled next week and this is impacting merchant payouts. Can you confirm what's happening and whether you intend to provide a credit for the outage window?

-Thomas
Senior SRE, NovaPay

Attachments: novapay-peak-sample-logs.tar.gz

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, NovaPay SREs <support@novapay.com>
Date: 2026-09-27T08:32:12-07:00
Subject: RE: Sudden latency & 503 spike this morning (Novapay prod) — escalated to execs

Marissa/Laura —

Looping you both in; customer (NovaPay) saw a sharp tail-latency and 503 spike during their morning peak. Preliminary look from logs (attached) points to a quota-window & burst-cap mismatch between the routing policy applied to their dedicated pool and the newly-deployed token-bucket tuning we shipped last week.

Observed so far:
- Token bucket refill window shortened from 1s to 200ms in the last deploy (burst-config-diff-20260927.patch) which reduced sustained throughput headroom but increased per-window exhaustion risk during microbursts.
- Smart-routing moved a subset of NovaPay traffic onto a lower-latency node group that has stricter per-route rate caps. When they hit a rapid burst the node-level safety valve curtailed traffic, causing queue buildup and upstream 503s.
- We have a clear reproduction in the attached logs and a suggested rollback patch.

Immediate asks (I propose we do all three and I need quick approvals):
1) Temporary burst override for NovaPay dedicated pool to increase per-window allowance by 3x for the next 2 hours.
2) Emergency rollback of the 200ms refill change to 1s for the next Canary to prevent recurrence.
3) Postmortem and customer credit conversation prepared by CS/legal.

I've attached: runbook-novapay-burst-override.md and infra-commands.txt with exact commands. Karthik, can you validate the commands and standby for exec approval to run them now?

Vivek
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Quoted from Thomas Nguyen:
> We're seeing a huge uptick in tail latency and 5xx responses ...
> Attaching sample logs.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Ops-Oncall <ops-oncall@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-27T08:40:03-07:00
Subject: RE: Sudden latency & 503 spike this morning (Novapay prod) — immediate mitigation

+1 to Vivek's plan. Approve temporary burst override now.

Action plan (executed immediately):
- Karthik to run the burst override command set in infra-commands.txt (increase per-window burst cap from 30 -> 90 tokens for NovaPay route).
- Ops-Oncall to monitor 1-minute tail latency and 503 rate; report back at :05 and :15 every 15 min.
- Laura: please sign off for credit evaluation and loop in CS/legal for SLA note.

Please execute and paste command output into this thread. We need a short note to the customer once latency drops.

-Marissa
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ops-Oncall <ops-oncall@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-27T08:47:56-07:00
Subject: RE: Sudden latency & 503 spike this morning (Novapay prod) — executing override

Running override now. Commands below (paste of infra-commands.txt):

> # grant temporary burst increase for route: novapay-prod-route
> redwoodctl rate override --route novapay-prod-route --burst-cap 90 --duration 120m --reason "emergency: peak burst backoff"

Command output:
- Applying override to 3 nodes in dedicated pool novapay-dedicated-01...
- Node a: success (old burst 30 -> new 90)
- Node b: success (old burst 30 -> new 90)
- Node c: success (old burst 30 -> new 90)
- Propagation complete across edge proxies: 12s

Monitoring: 08:50:10 PDT showing 503s dropping to 0.9% and median latency returning to 160ms. Continuing to monitor and will revert override once traffic stabilizes for 30 minutes.

Attachments: burst-config-diff-20260927.patch (applied rollback suggested)

—Karthik
Sr. Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal <legal@redwood.ai>, CS-Manager <cs-manager@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-27T09:10:22-07:00
Subject: RE: Sudden latency & 503 spike this morning (Novapay prod) — credit/rollback approval

Thanks team — good catch and fast action. I approve the temporary override and the rollback to 1s refill for the next canary; please schedule the rollback after the 3-hour observation window unless we see further anomalies.

Legal/CS: please prepare a customer-facing summary and a proposed SLA credit equal to 5% of September billings for the affected window (TBD after exact duration confirmed). Laura will sign the customer note.

Also, mark this as a P1 postmortem and request capacity/tonedown recommendations from Research/Runtime to avoid similar reflexive throttling.

-Laura
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Thomas Nguyen <thomas@novapay.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-27T20:46:02-07:00
Subject: RE: Sudden latency & 503 spike this morning (Novapay prod) — thank you

Vivek/Marissa —

Thanks for the rapid response and the update. We saw the 503s drop to negligible levels after the override; latency returned to normal. Appreciate the transparency and the proposed credit.

A couple of follow-ups from our side:
- We need a durable fix: can you confirm the timeline to revert the token-bucket tuning and the longer-term mitigations (routing policy alignment + pre-warming for peak windows)?
- For SLA/credit discussion: our finance team will expect a clear incident window and root cause summary. Please copy us on the postmortem.

We'll keep monitoring and will reach out if anything else pops up.

-Thomas
Senior SRE, NovaPay
